player_prompt.intro:
Nderehe Jogador {player_id} ({role}) peteĩ joaty {num_rounds}-hugua Matching Pennies. 
- Ára peteĩ, eñomi [heads] térã [tails] (térã [h], [t]).
- Nderehe ñe'ẽ tee joaty ndoguerohorýi, Jogador 0 oñeha'ã ára; ára puku, Jogador 1 oñeha'ã.
Eñomi ñe'ẽ tee '[heads]' térã '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Player 0 picked {choice0}; Player 1 picked {choice1}. Match -> Player 0 wins
message.round_mismatch: Player 0 picked {choice0}; Player 1 picked {choice1}. Mismatch -> Player 1 wins.
